channel.title: Crypto Daybook
channel.description: Crypto Daybook reports daily crypto news: market moves, Bitcoin and Ethereum updates, exchange and protocol developments, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: Get Your Wallet Ready for an NFT Mint in Seven Steps
item.description: A successful NFT mint starts with the right network, enough for the mint price and gas, and a verified transfer; these seven checks help funds arrive in time.

item.title: Set a Minimum Receive Amount for Cross-Chain Swaps
item.description: A minimum received amount sets the least destination token you will accept; calculate it from the full route quote, fees and slippage before signing.

item.title: Why bridged tokens can show different balances
item.description: A bridged token can show a different raw balance because decimals set display units; learn the conversion, rounding limits and checks that keep transfers clear.

item.title: Four Checks to Show ZeroFi zXMR in MetaMask
item.description: To show ZeroFi zXMR in MetaMask, check the active network, token contract, receiving address and confirmed transfer; the token may be on Sepolia.

item.title: Four Decimal Checks for Your First TRON Swap
item.description: A first TRON swap is easier to check when you verify token decimals, amount units, the quoted output and minimum received before signing the contract call.

item.title: Four checks when a USDT swap stalls on TRON
item.description: A delayed USDT swap on TRON may be waiting in your wallet, short on network resources or already failed; check its status before you retry the trade.

item.title: How TRON Energy affects frequent swaps
item.description: Frequent TRON swaps spend Energy each time a smart contract runs, so compare recurring resource costs with paying in TRX and check how your balance recovers.

item.title: How to Compare Cross-Chain Swap Routes
item.description: Compare cross-chain swap routes by the tokens you receive, total cost, timing, and execution steps, so you can judge the best fit for your transfer.

item.title: How to choose a concentrated liquidity range on Solana
item.description: A useful Solana liquidity range should match the price move you can tolerate and the time you can manage it, since fees stop when price leaves the range.

item.title: Check an ERC-20 Token Before You Bridge It
item.description: Before bridging an ERC-20, match its chain and contract address, confirm the bridge’s destination token mapping, and check approvals and transfer limits.

item.title: Why L2 withdrawals wait for published state roots
item.description: A withdrawal cannot be paid on Ethereum until its Layer 2 message is anchored in a published state root and checked; that wait ties the exit to verifiable data.

item.title: Why Monero Bridge Transfers Take More Than One Confirmation
item.description: Monero bridge timing depends on source-chain confirmations, bridge checks and destination-chain minting; learn which status to check before retrying an XMR transfer.

item.title: How to Budget TRX for Your First TRON Swap
item.description: A first TRON swap can cost more than the trade itself: check contract fees and available resources, then keep liquid TRX for any shortfall before you submit.

item.title: How wrapped assets shape a TRON swap route
item.description: Wrapped tokens let TRON swaps use assets represented as TRC-20 tokens, but route choice depends on token contracts, liquidity, fees and redemption trust.

item.title: What RingCT Hides When You Bridge Monero
item.description: RingCT hides Monero transfer amounts from public observers, but bridging to an EVM token changes what is visible; occasional users should know where privacy ends.

item.title: Why Monero bridge deposits can take longer than expected
item.description: Monero bridge deposits can feel slow when a wallet is still scanning old blocks. Learn how wallet sync, source confirmations and Sepolia delivery affect the wait.

item.title: ZeroFi bridge or swap? Choosing a route for XMR
item.description: A bridge gives XMR an Ethereum token form, while a swap trades it for another coin; choose by where you need the value to end up and what risks you accept.

item.title: Compare Cross-Chain Swap Quotes by What You’ll Receive
item.description: Cross-chain swap quotes estimate what reaches your wallet after fees, price movement, bridge steps and timing, so compare the received amount—not just the rate.

item.title: How to Estimate a Crypto Bridge Transfer Before Sending
item.description: A bridge quote is an estimate, not a promise: compare the source fee, route charge, arrival amount and timing before approving a cross-chain transfer.

item.title: How Polygon PoS checkpoints anchor withdrawals in 2026
item.description: Polygon PoS checkpoints commit Bor block ranges to Ethereum, letting withdrawals prove a burn before tokens can be released on Ethereum mainnet.
